name: Alameda County Fish and Wildlife Propagation Fund grants

funder.name: Alameda County Fish and Game Commission

summary: Annual small grants from a county fund fed by wildlife-law fines, for projects that benefit fish and wildlife in Alameda County, California, such as habitat improvement, conservation education and research. Awards mostly go to non-profits.
reporting: A short report of at least one page with photos or figures on the project's outcome or progress.

eligibility.rule: Project is a use that Fish and Game Code Section 13103 allows

documents: Organisation statement, board, officers and affiliates

status.quote: Completed applications are due by Friday, February 13, 2026.

deadline.quote: Please submit the completed proposal packet by 7 pm on Friday, February 13, 2026, including cover sheet, via email

calls.label: Next annual round
calls.recurring: The RFP is typically released in December, with applications due at the beginning of February each year.

status.quote: Typically, RFPs are released in December and completed applications are due at the beginning of February.

recurring.quote: Typically, RFPs are released in December and completed applications are due at the beginning of February.

applicant_types.quote: Organization /Individual applying: (organization type: please circle one - government, non-profit, for-profit, other (explain)

geography.quote: Expenditures made from the Fund must benefit the fish and wildlife resources of the County.

access.quote: Once a year, the Alameda County Fish and Game Commission (ACFGC) releases a Request for Proposals (RFP) for financial support of projects that meet our mandate.

window.quote: Typically, RFPs are released in December and completed applications are due at the beginning of February.

amount.quote: We anticipate the awarding 4-6 grants of up to $5,000 dependent upon our funds available and the quality of the grant applications.

reporting.quote: We require, at minimum, a 1-page report with photographs and/or figures sent via email to admin@alamedawildlife.org.

effort.quote: Please submit the completed proposal packet by 7 pm on Friday, February 13, 2026, including cover sheet, via email to the following two separate email addresses: admin@alamedawildlife.org and djohnson@sunol.net
Applicants may be asked to make a 10-15 minute video conference presentation to the Commission on either February 17 or 18, 4-6pm.

eligibility.quote: Projects awarded funds from the Fish and Wildlife Propagation Fund must meet the requirements of Section 13103 of the Fish and Game Code (attached) which describes the specific types of projects that are eligible.

after_award.quote: All recipients of ACF&G grant monies will be required to communicate the final outcome of their projects or an interim progress report by December 14, 2026.

documents.quote: Project schedule - Funds need to be expended a year from the date you receive the funding. Project budget (itemized).

Annual budget for the applying organization (NOT itemized). Statement describing the applying organization, listing the Board of Directors and officers of the organization, and listing all affiliated organizations. List of individuals responsible for performing project and individuals responsible for overseeing project.
Statement describing the status of permit approvals necessary to perform project (if applicable).
